verdict.rationale: Jira advertises 'Rich APIs'. Community users confirm a REST API they use to run queries and to script bug-report submission, so a first-party API clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at standard paths to verify coverage. missing for 10: documented API-to-UI parity, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec showing coverage of configuration, workflows, boards and admin, independent hands-on confirmation of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the ability to execute useful queries via REST on the data stored in there
I ended up writing some simple Jira API wrapper scripts for submitting bug reports quicker in our systems
